note: Nineteen harness, grader, and artifact-hygiene defects found while building this benchmark. Fixes use targeted regression tests where practical and fail-loud assertions or explicit publication caveats otherwise. Listed because a benchmark's credibility rests on how its own errors were caught and disclosed, not on claiming none remain. Source of truth for the generated report page.

defects.defect: Pre-fix L6/L7 staging copied hook scripts/manifests without active settings registration
defects.effect: Those discarded runs had hook payloads but zero hooks registered in active settings.json, so they could not measure hook-enforced behavior. The published rerun registered and executed the hooks.
Upstream relative imports crashed the format-enforcing hook
Clean cells were marked contaminated on an environment dump
Credential exposure in cells running with permissions bypassed
Scaffold documentation scored as a sandbox escape
Penalised only versions WITH hooks — silently favoured the control
Graded synthetic-persona answers against the operator's real profile
T5 grounding judged against materials the judge could not see

defects.defect: Fleet/Judge had no wave or vendor filter
defects.effect: A wave would have run 424 cells instead of 136; cross-vendor blinding was inexpressible
Orphaned browsers drove machine load to 13; inflated wall-clock and caused false timeouts

defects.defect: LeakCheck counted a kernel refusal as an escape
defects.effect: Invalidated a cell whose boundary held, when a browser crash handler probed the operator profile and was denied

defects.defect: Cell cwd inside the seatbelt's denied home
defects.effect: Emptied process.env for EVERY Bun hook, disabling the router and producing a routing result that was really a harness artifact

defects.defect: No node_modules in any staged install
defects.effect: Hooks import a YAML parser from a dozen of their own files; Bun's auto-install cannot write a tempdir inside the seatbelt, so the hook layer still could not start after the cwd fix

defects.defect: Staged install SHARED by every cell in a lane
defects.effect: Hooks wrote context-bearing state into the tree the next cell loads — cross-cell coupling, and a race at concurrency > 1

defects.defect: Hook-state capture copied vendored plugin docs
defects.effect: A bundled doc quoting an example home path landed in the graded artifact directory, where LeakCheck correctly read it as an escape and marked a clean cell contaminated

defects.defect: A skipped grader counted as a task failure
defects.effect: The golden set skips checks that cannot apply to a version — the control structurally cannot know the persona — so a documented exemption became a failure. Penalised only the control

defects.defect: Prompts a lane never ran counted against it
defects.effect: tier_models restricts T5 to two models, but pass@k divided by all 21 prompts regardless, so six of eight model lanes were graded on five prompts they were never scheduled to run. Understated every restricted lane by up to 23.8 points and produced the retracted claim that no model passes 100% bare

defects.defect: Retired-lane artifacts coexist with the live results tree
defects.effect: Retired FORK artifacts legitimately contain real identity. Each live lane root scans clean, but a whole results/ LeakCheck still reports 101 violating files because ignored retired copies remain there as well as in _archive. Publication verification must scan the explicit live lane roots until those duplicate retired paths are cleaned up.

defects.defect: Algorithm entry averaged with Algorithm skip
defects.effect: code:algorithm_read asks opposite questions on opposite prompts — observe an Algorithm-directory Read for heavy work, or no such Read for selected trivial work. A single combined column diluted the heavy-task result toward the trivial-task result. Split into separate columns keyed on the golden set's own expect field; L5 Terra remains the documented 2/4 skip exception.
